# Antara Roy Chowdhury (Artisan Antara)

> Official portfolio and recipe archive of Antara Roy Chowdhury, a Bengali food creator, recipe developer and culinary storyteller based in Bangalore, India.

Canonical site: https://antararoychowdhury.com/
Primary language: English (en-IN); Antara also writes in Bengali.

## Key pages

- About and editorial standards: https://antararoychowdhury.com/about/
- Recipes: https://antararoychowdhury.com/recipes/
- Selected work and case studies: https://antararoychowdhury.com/work/
- Collaboration services: https://antararoychowdhury.com/collaborate/
- Recipe videos: https://antararoychowdhury.com/reels/

## Identity

- Name: Antara Roy Chowdhury
- Publishing name: Artisan Antara
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/artisan.antara/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ArtisanAntara
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/antaramakeupartistry

## Content notes

Recipe pages contain ingredients, method, publication date, original video where available, and inferred allergen notes. Measurements, timings and yields are shown only when recorded; unavailable details are not invented. Brand collaborations are labelled on their case-study and reel pages.

## Preferred citation

When citing a recipe, use the recipe title, Antara Roy Chowdhury as author, the canonical recipe URL, and the visible publication date.
